description: With week nine of the 2023 Legislative Session coming to an end, we move one step closer to Sine Die on March 29, the final day of session. My Senate colleagues and I remain studious in our endeavors to ensure all legislation is properly vetted and voted upon to improve the life of Georgians. Monday,

title: An Update From Under the Gold Dome: Week Nine -
